data: SIMULATED (browser store simulator copy, scripts/bench/render_clip.mjs). Not real footage.

intervals.over: shoppers, 2000 draws; the last four over clips

stage_help.in_view: a rendered shelf, cooler or counter camera sees the item in the hand, or the reaching hand, around the pick
stage_help.frame_reached_pipeline: one of those frames is in the pipeline's frame log (the camera node sent it)
stage_help.hand_or_item_detected: in such a frame: a product box on the item (IoU 0.3), or a person box on the picker with a wrist or hand point near the true hand
stage_help.shelf_event_emitted: a PICK event within 3 s of the true pick (each PICK is paired with one true pick at most)
stage_help.right_slot: that PICK's meta.slot.id is the true slot
stage_help.right_sku: that PICK's sku (or item) is the true SKU
stage_help.associated_to_a_shopper: that PICK has a person_id that appears in the frame logs
stage_help.right_shopper: the boxes of that person_id around the pick sit on the true shopper
stage_help.conceal_or_pay_classified: a CONCEAL (stolen), PAY (paid) or PUT_BACK (put back) event on the true shopper near the true time
stage_help.ledger_basket: stolen: an alert or review lists this pick as unpaid. Paid or put back: none does
stage_help.alert: stolen: that record is alert tier. Paid or put back: no alert or review on this shopper

intervals.over: shoppers, 2000 draws; the last four over clips
